verdict.rationale: Filee documents audio transcoding to many formats (MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, Opus, AAC, WavPack, TTA) and video conversion through an optional FFmpeg engine. Video codec choice is limited to H.264 or HEVC via hardware encoders, and resolution control is shown only as a single 720p option. Missing for 10: any documented bitrate control, arbitrary resolution or scaling settings, a full list of video container/format targets, software codec selection beyond hardware H.264/HEVC, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
